Admission Rules

Prototype rules that the future backend will enforce server-side.

One permanent student record

Enrollment creates a student ID once; future sessions add enrollment history instead of duplicate profiles.

Active session only

New admissions attach to the current active academic session and assigned campus.

Enrollment after approval

Locked session = read-only

When the session is locked, new applications and admission decisions are disabled.

Connected to All Students

When an approved application is enrolled, the new student immediately appears in All Students with the same permanent student ID and preserved admission history.

Student Transfer Session 2026–2027 Main Campus Only

Student Transfer Center

School Admin/Principal handles the complete transfer process manually after the student or parent visits the school office. Select the student, enter all details, verify clearance, issue the certificate and finalize without deleting history.

School Office / Admin Managed Flow

Student or parent gives the transfer application to the school office physically. No Student Portal action is needed. Admin selects the student, enters guardian and destination details, uploads the written application, completes clearance, approves, prints TC/SLC and finalizes the transfer.

Admin Helper

Need an extra class? JuniCore can scan the selected day/period, show free rooms, verify teacher availability and schedule the extra class without creating a timetable clash.

Transfer Records

No student-portal request is required. Every transfer is created and managed manually by School Admin/Principal with its own clearance and audit trail.

Data Scope Is Separate

A permission controls what feature can open; data scope controls which records it can read/write. Teacher access stays tied to assigned classes/sections/subjects. Staff self-service stays tied to the logged-in staff ID.

Future Portal Contract

Teacher Portal

Own profile/attendance + assigned classes, students, timetable, duties and marks only.

Staff Portal

Own profile/attendance + assigned tasks. Role Workspace can later open role-specific features.

Parent Portal

Only children already linked to that Parent Account.

Role Templates

Admin starts from a safe template, then can customize menu permissions.

Backend Enforcement Later

Frontend hiding is only prototype behavior. Node/Express API must enforce campus, role, permission and record scope on every protected request.

Teacher / Staff / Parent Portal Contract

The future portals can consume the same permission IDs and scope rules.

Teacher Portal

Permission IDs start with teacher.. Scope comes from teacher ID + timetable/teaching assignments. Marks and attendance remain assignment-limited.

Staff Portal

Permission IDs start with staff.. Personal profile/attendance are self-only; tasks are assignment-only. Role Workspace can expand later.

Parent Portal

Permission IDs start with parent.. Every child query must also match a child ID already linked to that parent account.

Prototype Bridge

window.JuniCoreAccessControl exposes getAccess, can, isActive, getScope and getPortalMenu. In production these checks move to authenticated backend APIs.

Account Security

Change Password

Prototype validates the new password but never stores the actual password.

Production will verify the current password on the backend and store only a secure hash.
